moltres-skill-fire-spin.name: Fire Spin
moltres-skill-fire-spin.description: New skill: a vortex of fire at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 40) that Burns.

moltres-flame-body.name: Flame Body
moltres-flame-body.description: Its hits on adjacent foes Burn them for 2 turns.

moltres-flame-mantle.name: Flame Mantle
moltres-flame-mantle.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

moltres-skill-heat-wave.name: Heat Wave
moltres-skill-heat-wave.description: New skill: a scorching wind hits an area at range (Power 55) and Burns.

moltres-skill-flame-charge.name: Flame Charge
moltres-skill-flame-charge.description: New skill: a flaming dive at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60).

moltres-wildfire.name: Wildfire
moltres-wildfire.description: When a foe with its status faints, adjacent foes catch that status for 1 turn.

moltres-skill-sky-attack.name: Sky Attack
moltres-skill-sky-attack.description: New skill: a blazing dive up to 3 hexes away (Power 100) that pushes 1 hex.

moltres-skill-overheat.name: Overheat
moltres-skill-overheat.description: New skill: an all-out blast of fire at range (Power 95) that Burns.

moltres-rebirth.name: Rebirth
moltres-rebirth.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

moltres-burning-plumage.name: Burning Plumage
moltres-burning-plumage.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 8 damage.

moltres-skill-burn-up.name: Burn Up
moltres-skill-burn-up.description: New skill: pours all its fire into an adjacent foe (Power 100), Burning it.

moltres-skill-hurricane.name: Hurricane
moltres-skill-hurricane.description: New skill: a storm hits a foe up to 3 hexes away and pushes it 2 hexes (Power 90).

moltres-blazing-sky.name: Blazing Sky
moltres-blazing-sky.description: Capstone. After a KO on its turn: +2 movement and its basic attack again.

moltres-undying-flame.name: Undying Flame
moltres-undying-flame.description: Capstone. Heals 6% max HP each turn; +25% Fire damage below half HP.
